hypotheses.title: Batch 97: Unmined Cross-Domain Frontiers & Structural Decoupling Sprint
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly implements the user's directive to keep trying more data fields and hypotheses with radical uniqueness and disciplined caution. Deploys three academically backed hypotheses across three completely unmined datasets with zero past candidate overlap: (1) Candidate 1: The Novy-Marx (2013) Gross Profitability & Investment Growth Composite in model16, combining style pentagon profitability (fscore_bfl_profitability) with forecasted growth potential (fscore_bfl_growth). (2) Candidate 2: Options Market Maker Gamma Support & Breakeven Distance in option9, measuring spot cushion above the 60-day put breakeven level ((close - put_breakeven_60) / close). (3) Candidate 3: Systematic Market Correlation Decoupling in model51, identifying resilient equities whose 90-day market correlation decouples downward from their 1-year baseline (correlation_last_360_days_spy - correlation_last_90_days_spy). All candidates are 100% unit-clean, zero warnings, zero signed_power, and zero price-delta hedges.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if multi-factor profitability, options breakeven distance, or market correlation decoupling fail to produce Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Multi-Factor Pentagon Profitability & Growth Composite): Grounded in Novy-Marx (2013) and Fama-French (2015). Operating profitability and medium-term growth potential are the two strongest structural drivers of corporate return premia. Longs companies with historically elevated profitability and growth trajectories. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 2 (Options Put Breakeven Distance Support Floor): Put breakeven represents the open-interest weighted price at which downside option buyers break even. Equities trading comfortably above their 60-day put breakeven level enjoy positive market-maker gamma hedging support and low institutional tail-risk pricing. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 3 (Systematic Market Correlation Decoupling): Equities whose correlation to SPY drops significantly below their 1-year average reflect independent pricing power, company-specific catalysts, and macro resilience. Fades systematic co-movement to isolate idiosyncratic outperformance. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.
